Atom Minimization or Tree-Width Minimization Goal: Given k ∈ ℕ, a CRPQ γ, find another CRPQ δ s.t.  1. γ and δ are semantically equivalent, and 2. δ has at most k atoms,  /tree-width at most k.

children.name: Inexpressibility
Given a UCRPQ Γ, if its semantics contains a complex pattern, then any UCRPQ equivalent to Γ must be complex.
keywords: Given a UCRPQ Γ, if its semantics contains a complex pattern, then any UCRPQ equivalent to Γ must be complex.

children.name: Complexity: a class of graphs closed under minors. E.g.: at most k atoms, or tree-width at most k.
keywords: Complexity: a class of graphs closed under minors. E.g.: at most k atoms, or tree-width at most k.

children.name: Complex pattern containment: there exists a canonical database G of Γ s.t. : G is hom-minimal (amongst canonical databases), the segment graph of the core of G is complex.
keywords: Complex pattern containment: there exists a canonical database G of Γ s.t. : G is hom-minimal (amongst canonical databases), the segment graph of the core of G is complex.
